info.title: arXiv Universal API
info.description: Search and retrieve scholarly paper metadata from the public arXiv API, including articles, authors, categories, submission dates, and feed-level result metadata.

get.summary: Filter ID List By Search Query
get.description: Finds arXiv papers from an ID list matching a query.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: searchQuery
parameters.description: Full arXiv search expression used to filter the provided ID list.

schema.description: Full arXiv search expression used to filter the provided ID list.

parameters.name: idList
parameters.description: Comma-separated arXiv paper IDs to filter.

schema.description: Comma-separated arXiv paper IDs to filter.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

get.description: Retrieves a paper from arXiv by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: idList
parameters.description: Required single arXiv paper ID, for example 2501.01234 or cs/9901001.

schema.description: Required single arXiv paper ID, for example 2501.01234 or cs/9901001.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

author.description: Author list objects containing author names.

category.description: Category list objects from the Atom feed.

id.description: Canonical arXiv abstract URL for the paper version.

updated.description: Last update timestamp for this paper version.

parameters.description: Required arXiv search expression using the documented prefix syntax such as all:, ti:, au:, abs:, cat:, or submittedDate:[YYYYMMDDTTTT+TO+YYYYMMDDTTTT].

schema.description: Required arXiv search expression using the documented prefix syntax such as all:, ti:, au:, abs:, cat:, or submittedDate:[YYYYMMDDTTTT+TO+YYYYMMDDTTTT].

parameters.name: idList
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated arXiv IDs. When provided with Search Query, arXiv returns only IDs that also match the query.

schema.description: Optional comma-separated arXiv IDs. When provided with Search Query, arXiv returns only IDs that also match the query.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Optional arXiv sort field.

schema.description: Optional arXiv sort field.

parameters.name: sortOrder
